name: Websites - Authorized - File Transfer Services Domains [is]
description: Intent: Authorized file-transfer service domains — populate with sanctioned file-share platforms (e.g., wetransfer.com (Pro), aspera.ibm.com, tresorit.com, citrix-sharefile.com). Drives the Authorized split on M1050 and is negated in M1051 / W1051 / B1050 to define the unauthorized transfer surface. Lower priority — populate if you treat file-transfer as a distinct sanctioned channel separate from general cloud storage. Exclusions: do not add public consumer-tier file-sharing; do not add P2P / direct-share without audit controls.
